tools.name: chain-data_network-info
tools.description: Retrieve Base Mainnet chain ID and network information from the public JSON-RPC endpoint. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/chain-data/network-info. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: chain-data_block_latest
tools.description: Retrieve the latest block information from Base Mainnet using the public JSON-RPC endpoint. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/chain-data/block/latest. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: chain-data_block_get
tools.description: Retrieve a specific block by number or hash from Base Mainnet. Supports optional full transaction details. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/chain-data/block/get. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: chain-data_block_transactions
tools.description: Retrieve all transactions included in a specific block by number or hash from Base Mainnet. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/chain-data/block/transactions. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: chain-data_transaction_receipt
tools.description: Retrieve the receipt and status for a specific transaction on Base Mainnet, including logs and gas used. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/chain-data/transaction/receipt. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: chain-data_logs_search
tools.description: Search for contract event logs on Base Mainnet with filters for block range, address, and topics. Limited to 1000 results per request. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/chain-data/logs/search. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: chain-data_contract_code
tools.description: Retrieve the bytecode of a smart contract on Base Mainnet at a specific address and optional block number. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/chain-data/contract/code. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: chain-data_contract_read
tools.description: Execute a read-only call to a smart contract on Base Mainnet using eth_call. Returns the result without submitting a transaction. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/chain-data/contract/read. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: chain-data_gas_estimate
tools.description: Estimate the gas required for a transaction on Base Mainnet using eth_estimateGas. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/chain-data/gas/estimate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: chain-data_gas_fee-history
tools.description: Retrieve the fee history for Base Mainnet blocks, including base fees and reward percentiles. Supports EIP-1559. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/chain-data/gas/fee-history. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: chain-data_address_native-balance
tools.description: Retrieve the native ETH balance of a Base Mainnet address from the public JSON-RPC endpoint. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/chain-data/address/native-balance. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: chain-data_token_erc20-balance
tools.description: Retrieve the ERC-20 token balance of a wallet for a specified token contract on Base Mainnet using eth_call. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/chain-data/token/erc20-balance. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: chain-data_token_erc20-total-supply
tools.description: Retrieve the total supply of an ERC-20 token on Base Mainnet using eth_call. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/chain-data/token/erc20-total-supply. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: chain-data_token_metadata
tools.description: Retrieve ERC-20 name, symbol, decimals, and total supply for a token on Base Mainnet where supported. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/chain-data/token/metadata. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: chain-data_token_erc20-transfers
tools.description: Retrieve ERC-20 Transfer events for a token contract or wallet on Base Mainnet over a bounded block range. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/chain-data/token/erc20-transfers. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: chain-data_address_nonce
tools.description: Retrieve the transaction nonce for a Base Mainnet address from the public JSON-RPC endpoint. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/chain-data/address/nonce. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "chain-data" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: chain-data_network-info, chain-data_block_latest, chain-data_block_get, chain-data_block_transactions, chain-data_transaction_receipt, chain-data_logs_search, chain-data_contract_code, chain-data_contract_read, chain-data_gas_fee-history, chain-data_address_native-balance, chain-data_token_erc20-balance, chain-data_token_erc20-total-supply, chain-data_token_metadata, chain-data_token_erc20-transfers, chain-data_address_nonce · Private data: chain-data_token_erc20-balance, chain-data_token_erc20-total-supply, chain-data_token_metadata, chain-data_token_erc20-transfers · Public sink: chain-data_network-info, chain-data_block_latest, chain-data_block_get, chain-data_block_transactions, chain-data_transaction_receipt, chain-data_logs_search, chain-data_contract_code, chain-data_contract_read, chain-data_gas_estimate, chain-data_gas_fee-history, chain-data_address_native-balance, chain-data_token_erc20-balance, chain-data_token_erc20-total-supply, chain-data_token_metadata, chain-data_token_erc20-transfers, chain-data_address_nonce · Destructive: chain-data_network-info, chain-data_block_latest, chain-data_block_get, chain-data_block_transactions, chain-data_transaction_receipt, chain-data_logs_search, chain-data_contract_code, chain-data_contract_read, chain-data_gas_estimate, chain-data_gas_fee-history, chain-data_address_native-balance, chain-data_token_erc20-balance, chain-data_token_erc20-total-supply, chain-data_token_metadata, chain-data_token_erc20-transfers, chain-data_address_nonce.
